query_documents_with_filter.name: Query Documents with Field Filter
query_documents_with_filter.description: Search for documents in a category matching specific field criteria and iterate through results
use_cases: Find all orders for a customer

steps.description: Initiate async query with filter conditions
Fetch additional result batches if HasRemainingRows is true
Get detailed index data including structured table values
steps.when: Need detailed table data or all field values

common_errors.solution: Always call ReleaseSingleQuery in finally block
Check field name spelling or use FieldNo instead

create_document_web_client_flow.description: 4-step document creation process with validation and conditional logic

steps.description: Get category field definitions and constraints
Validate and normalize index data values
Apply conditional field logic and dependencies
Create document with validated index data and streams

map_index_values_to_columns.description: Map query result IndexValues array to field names using Columns array
map_index_values_to_columns.example_python:
def map_row(row, columns):
    return {columns[i]['ColName']: value for i, value in enumerate(row['IndexValues'])}
map_index_values_to_columns.example_javascript:
const mapRow = (row, columns) => 
  row.IndexValues.reduce((acc, val, i) => ({...acc, [columns[i].ColName]: val}), {})

batch_query_results.description: Paginate through large query result sets
batch_query_results.pattern:
1. ExecuteAsyncSingleQuery → get QueryId
2. While HasRemainingRows: GetNextSingleQueryRows
3. Always: ReleaseSingleQuery in finally block

api_quirks.explanation: Non-Therefore user accounts always return UserId 0 from user resolution APIs
api_quirks.workaround: Use username instead of UserId for AD/LDAP users

api_quirks.issue: Keyword fields require KeywordNos, not string values
api_quirks.explanation: Passing string values to keyword fields causes conversion errors
api_quirks.workaround: Resolve keyword strings to KeywordNos using GetDictionaryInfo first

api_quirks.issue: Table data in query results is concatenated strings
api_quirks.explanation: IndexValues for table fields contain delimited strings, not structured data
api_quirks.workaround: Use GetDocumentIndexData to retrieve structured table data

api_quirks.issue: DeleteDictionaryKeyword doesn't actually delete in-use keywords
api_quirks.explanation: API returns success but keyword remains if used in documents
api_quirks.workaround: Check keyword usage before attempting deletion

api_quirks.issue: ExecuteUsersQuery requires Flags=4 to list all users
api_quirks.explanation: Flags 0-3 silently return an empty Users array; Flags=63 returns only internal system accounts
api_quirks.workaround: Use {"Flags": 4} to list all regular named users
Use GetObjects {"Flags": 0, "Type": 11} and filter ItemList by Data==2 for groups (Data==1 = user, Data==3 = system principal)

api_quirks.explanation: Sending {"GroupNo": N} returns a 500 error ("Could not find group matching the name provided") because the server falls back to an empty group-name lookup - it fails loudly, not silently
api_quirks.workaround: Use {"GroupName": "..."} or {"GroupId": N} (GroupId is the group's numeric ID from GetObjects)

api_quirks.issue: GetCategoriesTree response shape differs from older docs
api_quirks.explanation: Response key is TreeItems (not CategoriesTree); items nest under ChildItems (not Children); the ID field is ItemNo, typed by ItemType (1=folder/FolderNo, 2=category/CategoryNo, 3=case definition/CaseDefNo)
api_quirks.workaround: Walk TreeItems recursively via ChildItems; filter ItemType==2 for queryable categories

api_quirks.issue: GetDocumentVersions and GetComments do not exist on the live server
api_quirks.explanation: Some client wrapper code references these endpoint names, but the live API 405s on GetDocumentVersions; the real comments endpoint is LoadComments
api_quirks.workaround: Use LoadComments {"ObjNo": N, "ObjType": 2, "MaxCount": N} for comments; there is no verified replacement for GetDocumentVersions

api_quirks.issue: CheckInDocument requires actual content to check in
api_quirks.explanation: Calling CheckInDocument with just {"DocNo": N} and no changes fails with "The document file is not open."
api_quirks.workaround: Use UndoCheckOutDocument to release a checkout without saving changes

api_quirks.explanation: Live testing showed RowBlockSize had no effect on ExecuteAsyncMultiQuery - all rows for each category were returned inline in the first response with HasRemainingRows: false, even when RowBlockSize was set well below the actual row count
api_quirks.workaround: For large result sets, use ExecuteAsyncSingleQuery per category instead - its pagination is confirmed reliable. Always call ReleaseMultiQuery when done regardless.

api_quirks.issue: GetCaseDefinition request parameter is CaseDefinitionNo, not CaseDefNo
api_quirks.explanation: Despite the response field being named CaseDefNo, the request body requires the longer key CaseDefinitionNo. CreateCase, by contrast, does use CaseDefNo as its request key
api_quirks.workaround: Use {"CaseDefinitionNo": N} for GetCaseDefinition and {"CaseDefNo": N} for CreateCase

api_quirks.issue: LinkCaseToDocument may not actually link despite returning success
api_quirks.explanation: In testing, {"CaseNo": N, "DocNo": N} returned 200 {} but the document did not subsequently appear in GetCaseDocuments
api_quirks.workaround: Verify the link took effect via GetCaseDocuments before relying on it; the minimal payload may be missing a required field (e.g. CategoryNo)

ExecuteAsyncSingleQuery.description: Execute async query against a category with filters and conditions

GetDocumentIndexData.description: Get complete index data for a document including structured table values

response_schema.IndexDataItems: array of index data by type

GetDocumentIndexData.use_when: Need structured table data or all field values

GetCategoriesTree.description: List the full folder/category/case-definition tree the user has access to

response_schema.TreeItems: array of tree nodes, each with ItemNo, ItemType (1=folder,2=category,3=case def), Name, FolderType, ParentFolderNo, ParentCaseDefNo, Guid, ChildItems (recursive)

GetCategoriesTree.notes: ItemType==2 nodes are queryable categories; their ItemNo is the CategoryNo

GetObjects.description: List users and groups together (no dedicated GetGroups endpoint exists)

response_schema.ItemList: array of {Data, ID, Name, Guid, Flags, FolderNo} - Data: 1=user, 2=group, 3=system principal

request_schema.GroupId: integer (alternative to GroupName; the group's ID from GetObjects)

GetUsersFromGroup.notes: GroupNo is NOT a valid parameter - use GroupName or GroupId

GetDocumentCheckoutStatus.description: Get the check-out state of a document

CheckOutStatus.CheckOutState: integer (0=not checked out, 1=checked out by caller)

UndoCheckOutDocument.description: Release a checkout without saving changes

response_schema.Comments: array of {ID, CommentText, CreatedByDisplayName, CreatedByUserNo, CreatedOn, LastModified, ObjNo, ObjType, AllowEdit}

AddComment.description: Add a comment to an object (document)
AddComment.notes: There is no DeleteComment endpoint - comments cannot be removed via the API

GetCaseDefinition.description: Get a case definition's linked categories and index fields

GetCase.description: Get case metadata and index data
GetCase.notes: Unknown/deleted CaseNo returns 500 ObjectDoesNotExist; a deleted case returns a distinct "case has already been deleted" error

GetCaseDocuments.description: List documents linked to a case

response_schema.CaseHistory: array of {ActionDate, EntryType, UserName, UserNo, Text, AdditionalInfo}

LinkCaseToDocument.description: Link a document to a case
LinkCaseToDocument.notes: UNVERIFIED effect: returns 200 {} but in testing the document did not appear in a subsequent GetCaseDocuments call. Confirm the link before relying on it.
